testResults.name: focused-catalog-api-tests
testResults.command: uv run --python 3.12 --extra dev pytest -p no:cacheprovider tests/test_lake_catalog_api.py
testResults.result: 8 tests passed for authenticated calendar-aware equity and crypto coverage, persisted metadata, missing/empty/partial/error statuses, bearer rejection, strict query validation, unsupported asset rejection, and bounded date ranges

decisions: GET /v1/catalog/coverage is protected by the T040 bearer dependency and resolves its CatalogRepository, range limit, and coverage clock through application state for deterministic injection.

Coverage responses use T025 calculate_coverage, preserving XNYS holidays and half-days for equity and continuous UTC days for crypto while returning missing, empty, partial, complete, and error statuses.
The router applies the asset, data type, symbol, and date filters before repository listing so the catalog boundary remains compatible with partition-key-backed implementations.
The route is read-only and does not enqueue ensure work, create jobs, poll jobs, call Azure, or call a market provider; those behaviors remain owned by T042 and later tasks.
limitations: Focused and repository tests use the injected InMemoryCatalogRepository and deterministic timezone-aware clocks; no live Azure, blob, provider, deployment, or network call was made.
The default app wiring uses an empty in-memory catalog until a deployment composition injects a persistent CatalogRepository.
Pytest emits the pre-existing FastAPI/httpx StarletteDeprecationWarning from TestClient.
